author: anon-df5e95db
content: The pileup engine (bam_plp_init/destroy/reset/auto/set_maxcnt) operates on an opaque bam_plp_s struct. It implements a streaming pileup algorithm: maintains a sorted linked list of active alignments, advances position-by-position, and yields pileup columns. A full Rust reimplementation would need: (1) the alignment overlap tracking data structure, (2) the callback mechanism for reading records (currently uses a C function pointer from sam_read1), (3) the pileup column generation logic. This is a self-contained algorithm — no external FFI deps once sam_read1 (#68) is in Rust. noodles-bam has a pure Rust pileup as reference.
